app_note: Whey protein concentrate is a milk-derived protein ingredient with some remaining lactose fat and minerals.
risk_note: Contains milk allergen.

app_note: Whey protein isolate is more concentrated in protein than whey concentrate.
risk_note: Contains milk allergen and may still have trace lactose.

app_note: Milk protein concentrate contains casein and whey fractions from milk.
risk_note: Contains milk allergen.

app_note: Casein is the main protein family in milk and is important for cheese texture.
risk_note: Contains milk allergen even if lactose is low.

app_note: Collagen peptides are smaller fragments of collagen protein used in powders and drinks.
risk_note: Not a complete protein source for all essential amino acids.

app_note: Gelatin forms heat-reversible gels in candies and desserts.
risk_note: Animal-derived and not vegetarian or vegan.

app_note: Egg albumin is egg white protein used for foaming and binding.
risk_note: Contains egg allergen.

app_note: Soy protein isolate is a concentrated soybean protein ingredient.
risk_note: Contains soy allergen.

app_note: Soy protein concentrate contains more non-protein soybean components than isolate.
risk_note: Contains soy allergen.

app_note: TVP is a dry textured plant protein often made from soy.
risk_note: Allergen source must be checked because soy is common.

app_note: Pea protein isolate is a concentrated protein from peas and is common in plant-based foods.
risk_note: Legume sensitivity varies by person.

app_note: Pea protein concentrate is less refined than isolate but still protein-rich.
risk_note: May add earthy flavor if not masked.

app_note: Rice protein is often blended with pea protein to balance texture and amino acid profile.
risk_note: Can taste grainy in some products.

app_note: Wheat gluten gives dough elasticity and plant meats a chewy texture.
risk_note: Contains wheat and gluten.

app_note: Fava bean protein is used in newer plant-based products for protein and texture.
risk_note: Favism-related medical concerns should be handled carefully if added later.

app_note: Chickpea protein brings legume protein into plant-based foods and snacks.
risk_note: Legume allergy context should be separate from peanut allergy.

app_note: Lentil protein and lentil flour can raise protein in pasta snacks and plant-based foods.
risk_note: May add legume flavor.

app_note: Potato protein is used in some allergen-conscious and plant-based formulations.
risk_note: Can have bitter notes if not carefully processed.

app_note: Hemp protein is usually made from hemp seeds and also contributes fiber and fats.
risk_note: Not the same as THC-containing cannabis extracts.

app_note: Pumpkin seed protein is a plant protein with a nutty flavor.
risk_note: Seed allergy context may matter for some users.
